title: Custom Data Commons theme configuration
description: Schema for an instance's theme.json configuration. Colors, fonts, and radii map to --theme-* CSS custom properties in ui/src/index.css; content and asset fields map to InstanceConfig in ui/src/config/instance_config.ts.

metricsTile.description: One tile → one <datacommons-${type}> web component on the Key Metrics dashboard. `title` is the card's chrome header; the rest pass through as attributes.

variables.description: Space-separated StatVar DCIDs for multi-series tiles.

instance_name.description: Display name of the instance, e.g. 'India Data Commons'. Shown in the header/title.

domain_hint.description: Domain or DNS-safe label for the instance (informational).

logo.description: Same-origin path starting with '/' (e.g. '/dc-logo.svg'), http(s) URL, or config-bucket-relative path (e.g. 'assets/logo.png', rewritten by the deploy-time injection step) to the instance logo.

logo_height.description: Header logo height, e.g. "28px" (--theme-logo-height). Omitted, the bundled Data Commons mark renders at its natural 28px — the same size datacommons.org uses.

logo_text.description: Wordmark rendered beside the logo in the header, e.g. "Data Commons". When a custom theme overrides `logo` or `instance_name` and omits `logo_text` (or sets it to ""), the header renders the logo mark alone.

logo_alt.description: Alt text for the logo image.

favicon.description: Same-origin path starting with '/' (e.g. '/dc-logo.svg'), http(s) URL, or config-bucket-relative path (e.g. 'assets/logo.png', rewritten by the deploy-time injection step) to the favicon.

colors.description: Theme palette. Applied as --theme-* CSS variables; each maps to a design token in ui/src/index.css with a built-in fallback, so omitted keys keep the shipped design value.

primary.description: Primary interactive color: active nav tabs, links, buttons, send button (--theme-primary → --color-theme-primary).

accent.description: Accent color (--theme-accent → --color-theme-accent) used in the prompt input focus glow ring.

gradient_start.description: Hero 'Data Agent' heading gradient start stop (--theme-gradient-start → --color-theme-gradient-start).

gradient_end.description: Hero 'Data Agent' heading gradient end stop (--theme-gradient-end → --color-theme-gradient-end).

surface_narrative.description: Tile behind a rendered narrative — response card and its skeleton (--theme-surface-narrative → --color-surface-narrative).

skeleton_bar.description: Skeleton ('ghost loader') bars shown while a narrative streams in (--theme-skeleton-bar → --color-skeleton-bar).

container.description: Tonal-button container, e.g. the Export button (--theme-container → --color-theme-container). Omitted, it is mixed automatically from `primary`.

on_container.description: Tonal-button label and icon (--theme-on-container → --color-on-theme-container). Omitted, it follows `primary`.

nav_active.description: Active header-tab label and underline (--theme-nav-active → --color-nav-active). Omitted, it follows `text`.

radius.description: Corner radii as CSS lengths. Applied as --theme-radius-* CSS variables; each maps to a design token in ui/src/index.css with a built-in fallback, so omitted keys keep the shipped design value.

card.description: Cards, response tiles and message bubbles (--theme-radius-card → rounded-card). Default 16px.

headline.description: Hero heading on the empty Data Agent screen, e.g. "Data agent explorer".

tagline.description: Sub-heading under `headline`, e.g. "powered by Google's Data Commons".

navigation.description: Header navigation entries. An empty array renders no header menu.

suggestions.description: Starter prompt suggestions on the empty Data Agent screen.

footer.description: Reserved; not currently read by the UI.

ga_tag_id.description: Google Analytics tag ID; empty string disables analytics. Reserved; not currently read by the UI.

splash_assets.description: Same-origin paths starting with '/', http(s) URLs, or config-bucket-relative paths (rewritten by the deploy-time injection step) for the turn-state indicator marks.

thinking_indicator.description: Path or URL of the animated mark shown while a turn is streaming.

done_indicator.description: Path or URL of the mark shown once a turn has finished.

metrics.description: Key Metrics dashboard composition. When absent, or when `tabs` is empty, the Key Metrics page renders its empty state.
